* '''PC-E1''' ([[Captain Moden Canady (Errata)]]): PC card image of 8 December 2025<ref name="ht-mc-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/22b59ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Dark/large/captainmodencanady.gif captainmodencanady.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/22b59ba 22b59ba] (8 December 2025).</ref>, no errata mark.
